scope: Single-HNL, exclusive single-flavour benchmark. This overlay is not a likelihood or an exclusion of the neutrino ring.
interpolation: Log-linear in mass between adjacent distinct published points; no extrapolation. Duplicate mass knots are retained as transitions and have no single interpolated limit.
missing_for_model_exclusion: decay widths and branching fractions including new scalar/gauge channels
